name: store_reuse_staging_tlx
description: P1-2 staging-buffer reuse (tests/e2e/kernels/lkv_e2e_store_reuse_tlx.py `staging`): 64x64 fp16 tiles stored by TMA from one shared-memory staging buffer, TILES = columns / 64. drain_*: the buffer is rewritten only after `cp.async.bulk.wait_group.read 0` and a named barrier (P1-2 PASS); race_*: right away (P1-2 FAIL from the second tile on; race_one_tile has one tile, nothing to reuse: PASS). P0 must pass on every input (PTX translation). The legacy TTGIR translation refuses tlx.named_barrier_wait (ttng.user_named_barrier_id): run it with --frontend ptx, which also writes the P1-2 KIR.
